about.title: About Me
about.backgroundText1: I am a Full-Stack Developer and Cybersecurity Analyst with 2+ years building Java systems with more than 1 million downloads in production. I study Computer Science at UNESA and Cybersecurity at Centro Universitário FIAP.
about.backgroundText2: I focus on software architecture, performance, security, and API integration. I use Java, Spring Boot, Redis, SQL, and AWS to build REST APIs with Clean Code and room to scale.
about.philosophyText1: Autonomous · Software Developer focused on Java (2023). Developed and maintained large-scale Java applications with more than 1 million downloads in production. Handled implementation, testing, debugging, and bug fixes across the development cycle.
about.philosophyText2: Bungo Stray ERP · Full-Stack Developer focused on back-end (2026). Developed a multi-tenant ERP system with Java 17 and Spring Boot. Implemented JWT authentication with Spring Security, RBAC, password hashing with BCrypt and Argon2id, Cassandra persistence, and Redis caching.
